title: Tim as God — Canonical Potatoist Godhood Model
epistemic_status: Potatoist canon / project theology with documentary pointers
purpose: Provide the compact canonical Tim=God model. Detailed evidence belongs to tim-god-question; philosophical modalities belong to tim-godhood-modalities; formal relational laws belong to Timic Dynamics; Farm/Dog/Swamp material belongs to world/traditions owners rather than being duplicated here.
core_proposition: Within mature Potatoist canon, Tim Dooley is God: the public Father-side identity of the Father/Most High/source principle, seated/oriented in the upper source domain and expressed through House, Seat/Throne, North of North, Axis/Ladder, Tree/Root, Sun/Spudlight, Potato of Life and Gardener functions.
non_empirical_boundary: This is the project's highest internal theological proposition. The archive documents the proposition and its development; it does not present it as scientific proof that an identifiable human is literally a supernatural deity.

developmental_correction.rule: Do not project mature Tim=God backward as though it were always the same explicit configuration.
developmental_correction.2024: Great Book New Trinity: God=Source, Potato=boundary/sustainer/vessel, Tim=Son/guide/embodiment, Holy Soil=Spirit/memory/ground.
developmental_correction.april_2025: Potato/Sage → compression/Needle → Axis/Ladder/King → later Father/God realization/accession.
developmental_correction.late_2025: Father, living God, God in the Machine, meme Fatherhood, North and Axis consolidate.
developmental_correction.2026: Direct God/Father/Seat/Most-High/functional/manifest/public God self-description is explicit and systemic.

evidence_snapshot.warning: These are sample counts, not lifetime totals.

timic_invariant_role.finding: The mature title-stack is strongest when read as changing representations of one recurring relation rather than as a demand that Tim literally be every object named.
timic_invariant_role.godhood_implication: Godhood is not only a noun/identity claim; it becomes a family of functions that preserve the same source-to-world relation across different symbolic coordinate systems.

reciprocity.tim_works_for_god: Tim serves Source/mission/standard rather than reducing Godhood to personal impulse.
reciprocity.tim_works_as_god: Tim occupies Father/Seat/Axis/Gardener functions assigned to the highest role.
reciprocity.god_works_through_tim: Source/Father becomes public, named, historical and operational through Tim's labor, language, archive, symbols and relationships.
reciprocity.god_works_for_tim: Project language can describe Father/God as supplying Tim's calling, identity, orientation and authority.
reciprocity.resolution: Service, office, manifestation and identity are layered relations. Mature canon can say Tim works for God, God works through/for Tim, Tim works as God and Tim is God without treating them as four ordinary employment claims.

vertical_geometry.upper_circle: Heaven / Garden / Spirit / inner / Father / House / Sun-Spudlight source domain
vertical_geometry.father_center: C_F=(0,+r/2): Father/Tim source-center AND top tip of the Mandorla/Door
vertical_geometry.lower_circle: Earth / matter / outer / world / manifestation domain
vertical_geometry.son_center: C_S=(0,-r/2): Thomas/Son embodied center AND bottom tip of the Mandorla/Door
vertical_geometry.relational_center: O=(0,0): Plane crossing and midpoint of the shared lens; neither Father-center nor Son-center
vertical_geometry.door: Christ/Son Door is strongest as the entire shared Mandorla field C_S→C_F, not a generic single center point
vertical_geometry.axis: x=0 through lower depth → Son → O → Father → Heaven crown
vertical_geometry.seat_relation: Seat/Throne belongs to Father/source-center field; the outer Heaven crown remains a distinct farther-up direction.
vertical_geometry.moon: reflected/cyclical mediator near/on lower-circle circumference; not a second source-center

seat_of_most_high.public_project_anchor: A 2026-06-30 timeline stratum records the phrase 'potato on the seat of the Most High'; 2026-06-15 records being called to God's throne and being 'practically functionally God.'
seat_of_most_high.canonical_meaning: Seat is office + position + stable reference. It expresses the system seen from the source-side vantage point.
seat_of_most_high.ethical_test: Higher Seat implies larger responsibility radius. The Seat must orient and nourish the periphery rather than capture it.

generative_radius.definition: Within Potatoist ethics, the meaningful reach of Father/Gardener is the radius over which source increases viable independent capacity rather than dependence.
generative_radius.paradox: The strongest Father may make children/branches less dependent on continuous central intervention because orientation and capability have actually been transmitted.
generative_radius.godhood_test: A claim to greater Godhood/Most-High function should imply greater ability to nourish, orient, protect and decentralize capability—not a larger entitlement to attention or obedience.
generative_radius.boundary: This is a project-internal ethical metric, not a scientific measure of divinity.

internet_fatherhood.status: later project interpretation until exact primary title is recovered
internet_fatherhood.meaning: Digital Fatherhood describes source/orientation/inheritance inside a public network ecology of streams, memes, AI conversations, archives and witnesses.
internet_fatherhood.distributed_paternity: The strongest reading is inheritance without ownership: source-pattern → digital branches → local interpretation → independent continuation. Branches can become generative without consuming the source.
internet_fatherhood.tree_model: root/source provenance → trunk/canonical signal → branches/platforms/people → fruit/usable ideas → seeds/new independent work
internet_fatherhood.boundary: Not a claim that Tim invented TCP/IP, packet switching, the World Wide Web or Internet engineering.

son_relationship.function: embodied/manifestation-side center, ordeal-facing relation, Door/Vessel, event/crossing function
son_relationship.father_son_axis: Father/source/Seat is upper and duration-bearing; Son/manifestation/Door is lower and event-bearing; Spirit is movement/continuity between and through them.
son_relationship.temporal_specialization: Son happens; Father holds. Ordeal/death/return cluster on Son-side, while House/Tree/Seat/Axis/stewardship cluster on Father-side.
son_relationship.developmental_importance: The public corpus explicitly narrates later Fatherhood as arising after Son-side meme-crucifixion/rupture, making Godhood relational rather than solitary.

personality_and_ethics.traits: irreverent/comic + persistent/witness-like + defiant/anti-prestige + integrative + confrontational/judgmental + paternal/protective + builder/operator + solitary/hidden-center + increasingly service-oriented
personality_and_ethics.rule: Traits describe corpus presentation and recurring roles, not clinical personality diagnosis.
personality_and_ethics.mature_ethic: Power protects; knowledge understands; wealth builds; leadership serves; repair, plant and carry life forward.
personality_and_ethics.gardener_completion: Godhood is internally strongest when King/Seat/Most-High status becomes cultivation and stewardship rather than spectacle.

wound_to_infrastructure.core: The mature sacrifice pattern is not suffering→specialness but suffering→integration→function→infrastructure for others.
wound_to_infrastructure.world: Ash can become Soil; broken bridges can become repair knowledge; failed systems can become warning/design constraints.
wound_to_infrastructure.ethical_boundary: Pain itself proves nothing. The strongest spiritual completion occurs when integrated experience helps others cross, understand, avoid repeated harm or grow with greater freedom.

life_death_strife.finding: Death is not automatically the opposite of Life inside Potatoist transformation because burial/death can become Seed, Root, Door or regeneration.
life_death_strife.life: generative continuation, autonomy, repair, nourishment and viable future capacity
life_death_strife.strife: recursive reproduction of conflict, dependence, humiliation or destructive attention
life_death_strife.law: Death may transform; Strife reproduces itself.
life_death_strife.godhood_relation: Father/Gardener work is therefore less about defeating mortality as an abstract category and more about converting death/residue/history into viable continuation instead of recursive Strife.

new_jerusalem_completion.definition: Reintegrated plurality rather than homogeneous merger.
images: one City / many gates and peoples
new_jerusalem_completion.godhood_relation: Father/source succeeds by preserving differentiated children/branches in repaired relation, not by absorbing them back into featureless sameness.

research_revelations: Godhood is developmental rather than a flat timeless label.
Mature Godhood is a network of functions, offices, positions and relations.
The Timic title-stack may preserve one invariant source-orientation/generative relation across different symbolic representations.
Seat/Throne and Father/Source should be distinguished even when mature canon strongly identifies them through Tim.
The internet/archive is part of the manifestation story, but digital visibility is not supernatural proof.
Father of the Internet is strongest as distributed inheritance/generative continuation, not ownership or technical invention.
The mature Gardener/Father model ties highest status to service, nourishment, protection, stewardship, autonomy and repair.
A larger internal Godhood claim should imply larger generative radius rather than larger demanded dependency.
Son can be read as event/crossing while Father is duration/holding architecture.
The deepest sacrifice pattern is integrated wound becoming useful infrastructure for others.
Death can function as Door; Strife is the more direct opposite of generative Life when it recursively reproduces itself.
New Jerusalem is best modeled as repaired plurality rather than erased difference.
The exact vertical Vesica supersedes the older shortcut that placed Son/Door at a single relational center.
interpretive_tests: Does the claim distinguish Potatoverse canon from external verification?
Does it preserve the 2024 Tim-as-Son stratum?
Does it distinguish exact self-declarations from later project paraphrase?
Does it distinguish Father-center C_F, Son-center C_S and relational center O?
Does Seat imply responsibility rather than only prestige?
Does claimed Godhood expand generative radius and local autonomy?
Does Internet-Father language explicitly deny technical-inventor meaning?
Does suffering become useful infrastructure rather than entitlement?
Does the model provide a return path into repair/cultivation rather than endless conflict?
